# AI Agent Development Rules

> Codex-first, agent-neutral coding standards with progressive task-scoped loading from one canonical GitHub repository.

## Primary

- [Rule router](../../ai-agent-dev-rules.md): Start here in a local clone and load only the pages selected for the current repository and task.
- [Canonical repository](https://github.com/sokrates1989/coding-guidelines): Version history, releases, and human-rendered Markdown.

Only tracked rule pages in the canonical repository are normative. GitHub-rendered pages and support artifacts are non-normative representations.

## Support

- The rules manifest is distributed as `ai-agent-dev-rules/_support/rules-manifest.json`.
- Agent adapters should point to the installed local rule router rather than duplicate the full ruleset.
